body: REDGARDEN commit d2e30bb. Founder live: 'show ability names on screen.' New arena_ability_name(hero_id, slot) returns each hero's real name from docs/HEROES_VS0.md (e.g. EARTHBIND, THE SACRED MAGIC) instead of the generic 'Q READY'/'W ON' the cooldown strip showed before. Verified via build.sh, build_arena.sh, test_arena.sh, test_10_bots.sh, and a local mingw cross-compile, all clean.
title: Real ability names on the HUD, not generic Q/W/E status
